name: Ramsay Health Care Limited
summary: Ramsay Health Care Limited owns and operates hospitals in Australia, the United Kingdom, France, and the Nordics. It offers services in various therapeutic areas, such as cardiology, oncology, orthopaedics, and mental health. The company also provides hospital in the home and telehealth services; and clinical specialties to private and self-insured patients, and patients referred by the NHS, as well as operates health clinics and pharmacy retail franchise network. It offers health care services to public and private patients. The company was founded in 1964 and is based in St Leonards, Australia.
